title: View Kind nemar.signal-window, Version 1
description: A window of the recording as the serving copy holds it, opened in the signal viewer, a preset over nemar.lines version 1, applied on top of the envelope to a view declaration whose kind is nemar.signal-window and kind_version 1. The role signal is the recording's store; the window starts at parameters.start_s and lasts parameters.duration_s. The optional roles channels and badsegments are the floor's decisions, which a renderer marks over the window (bad channels and bad segments). Nothing is computed or stored: the view names a window of data the viewer already reads under the dataset's read rule. docs/views/presets.md is normative.

base.description: The window is drawn as lines over time, one per channel.

data.description: The window is read from the serving copy; nothing is stored.

transform.description: The window is drawn as the store holds it.

inputs.description: The role signal, once, and the optional roles channels and badsegments.

oneOf.description: The recording's store in the serving copy.
A table of the floor's decisions: the channels (the floor's _channels.tsv, whose status column marks bad channels) or the bad segments (its _badsegments.tsv, onset and duration in seconds).

start_s.description: The window's start, in seconds from the recording's first sample.
